They belonged to a designated clan in the Other Side Camp where all earthly powers originated. When a Crow honorable passed from this earth he joined his medicine's clan as one in the Other Side Camp. As a rule the Crows prayed to the medicine bundle object spirit, which in turn would pray to the first maker for the individual.
Clans
The Crow clan system originally consisted of thirteen matrilineal divisions (all children being members of their mothers's clan). The clans were bonded together usually in twos (phratrics) and the role of clans was to regulate marriages as well as to offer assistance to fellow members in times of need and in ceremonial functions. The ten remaining functional clans are paired together as follows:
Greasy Mouth - Sore Lips Whistling Waters - Bad War Deeds Newly-made Lodges - Husky People Tied Up in a Bundle - Bring Game Without Hunting Filth Eaters - Piegan
(Westmoreland Resources, 1975 f)
